headline: Search CPC drops a fifth; $6,517 NP on $28,027 of media
commentary:
### The day
- **$6,517 NP at 18.9% margin**, nearly double last Tuesday on a third less spend.
  - NP: $6,517 v $3,468 last Tue
  - NM: 18.9% v 7.9%
  - Cost: $28,027 v $40,609
- Above the eight-Tuesday average, but on the quietest volume of that run.
  - Eight-Tue mean NP: $5,253
  - Leads: 2,266 v 3,076 mean
  - Cost: $28,027 v $45,815 mean
- October stays ahead of September on far less media.
  - MTD NP: $149,294 v $132,203
  - MTD cost: $876,466 v $1,123,646
### What drove it
- Search did the same job cheaper rather than bigger.
  - Search CPC: **$10.85** v $13.52 last Tue
  - Search cost: $21,287 v $34,099
  - Impression share: 10.0% v 10.3%
- The spend came out of the two biggest campaigns.
  - payday_alternative: $5,572 v $10,477
  - generic: $3,347 v $7,067
- Lead value was soft, but inside the usual Tuesday spread.
  - EPL: $15.24 v $16.57 eight-Tue mean
  - Search EPL: $28.26 v $31.20 last Tue
  - Direct (Inc ZP) EPL: $17.08 v $20.99 last 7
- **Bing** flipped from loss to profit on better-paying leads.
  - Bing NP: $1,212 v -$761 last Tue
  - Bing EPL: $13.84 v $9.01
  - Bing leads: 411 v 303
### Tests
| Test | Set-up | Spend 27/10 | Spend wk ago | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| competitor off SAs | tROAS, no cap | $735 | $1,023 | — |
| speed | high tROAS, walking down | $278 | $1,396 | — |
| Scavenger pair | tROAS v tCPA copy | $1,450 | $1,238 | — |
- speed is pocket money while the target walks back down, as planned.
  - speed spend: $278 v $1,396 last Tue
  - speed clicks: 19 v 67
- Scavengers still picking clicks up at a third of Search CPC.
  - Scavenger spend: $1,450 v $1,238 last Tue
  - competitor_scavenger CPC: $3.48 v $10.85 Search
watch: EPL at $15.24 sits at the bottom of the eight-Tuesday range, so we're tracking whether it settles back nearer $16.50.
Search CPC of $10.85 against $12.00 month-to-date — we're following whether the softer auctions hold or yesterday was a one-off.
